run_pipeline_profiling: run the pipeline profiling example to benchmark each stage at different concurrency levels
create_pipeline_config: create a pipeline configuration with multiple processing stages using PipelineConfig and Pipe
profile_pipeline_stages: profile pipeline stages independently across concurrency levels using profile_pipeline to find optimal settings
plot_profile_results: plot profiling results showing QPS versus concurrency for each pipeline stage with matplotlib
print_profile_result: print profiling result for a single stage showing QPS and occupancy rate per concurrency level
